request.label: r3-verify-perturbed-recovery-1
command:
import sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from physical_cache_history_check import binary_history
from resources import atomic, identity
from task2r_advancing import identity_of_state, read, require
from task2r_advancing_evidence import HASH_KEYS
import physical_transient_oracle as transient
r=Path(sys.argv[1])
c=r/"science-r3/r3-prefix-perturbed"
q=r/"science-r3/r3-audit-signed-perturbation/audit.json"
proof=read(q)
plan=read(c/"admission.json")
operation=r/"operations/r3-prefix-perturbed/receipt.json"
status=read(operation)["result"]
initial, frame, binary=(c/n for n in ("state.science-0.json","state.science-1.json","state.recovery-1.bin"))
start=identity_of_state(initial)
step=identity_of_state(frame)
_, checkpoint=binary_history(binary,step,.04,time.monotonic()+15)
log=c/"state.steps.jsonl"
journal=read(log)
require(plan["represented_proof"]==identity(q) and proof["status"]=="MET"
        and status["status"]=="FAIL" and status["reason"] in ("HOST_WORKER_LIMIT","HOST_PRESSURE_REMAINS","TIME_LIMIT")
        and start["state_sha256"]==proof["state_sha256"]==step["previous_sha256"]
        and checkpoint["step"]==step["step"]==journal["step"]==1
        and step["time"]==checkpoint["time"]==journal["time"]==.04
        and all(step[key]==journal[key]==checkpoint["hashes"][role] for role,key in HASH_KEYS.items())
        and all(transient.state_hash(step["input_history"][role])==start[key] for role,key in HASH_KEYS.items())
        and max(step["residuals"])<=1e-10,
        "accepted perturbation and actual recovery histories differ")
atomic(r/"evidence/r3-perturbed-recovery-1.json",dict(schema="WJH27R3RecoveredPrefixAnchorV1",
    status="MET",initial=identity(initial),accepted=identity(frame),recovery=checkpoint,step_log=identity(log),
    operation=identity(operation),signed_represented=identity(q),state_hashes={k:step[k] for k in HASH_KEYS.values()}))
